headline: 漫威双片霸榜，影市平淡待新作
headlineEn: Marvel double-feature dominates charts; box office quiet awaiting new titles
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅2部新片入市。漫威《复仇者联盟5》与《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑热搜，诺兰《奥德赛》紧随其后，市场热度集中但缺乏新片刺激。
summaryEn: No releases today, only two new films this week. Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday and Spider-Man: Brand New Day lead trending, followed by Nolan's The Odyssey. Market buzz is concentrated but lacks fresh titles.
